spec.task_text: Approach the handle from the side and press it downward.
spec.on_service_error: if a call fails with a connection error or 5xx, the service may have crashed and resumed the same episode (never a reset): the state is the one after the last call that completed on the service, which you may not have received; check GET /status (control_steps) before continuing
spec.camera_calibration: meta["cameras"][cam] of every response: intrinsic_cv (pinhole, pixels) and cam2world_gl (4x4, OpenGL axes: x right, y up, the camera looks along -z; the viewpoint the image is rendered from). The cameras are fixed (moving = false): the calibration is the same in every response.

ee_delta.units: dx, dy, dz: 1.0 = 1 cm of hand-target motion per control step (world frame); grip: -1 open .. +1 close
ee_delta.semantics: Meta-World's native action, applied once per control step: the hand's mocap target moves by [dx, dy, dz] x 0.01 m (kept inside the workspace box), the arm follows it through a weld constraint, and grip is the finger actuators' command (+1 closes, -1 opens). The wrist orientation is fixed.
ee_delta.rows: rows `dt` apart (a multiple of control_dt, >= control_dt); each row is applied at every control step it covers (interpolate=hold) or ramped linearly from the previous row (linear); clipped to [lower, upper]. With dt = control_dt both are the same: one row = one native action.

spec.frames: world frame: x to the robot's right, y forward (away from the robot base), z up; metres

budget.clock: meta time_s / time_left_s count from your first request to the service (any endpoint), not from the service's start, and keep running through a restart of the service; time_left_s = budget.wall_clock_s - time_s. The harness counts the same limit from the start of your session, so time_left_s never runs out before the harness stops you: your real time left is time_left_s minus the time you spent before that first request. Plan by time_left_s.

spec.episode: runs until your time is up; the state after the last executed control step is graded

ee_delta.frame: arm channels: end-effector deltas in the robot base frame, scaled by the controller (1.0 = 5 cm / 0.5 rad per control step); base and torso channels: robot base frame
ee_delta.semantics: the robot's native composite-controller command (robosuite), applied once per control step; kinds: delta = motion per control step (0 holds still), absolute = target, grip / mode = held setting
ee_delta.hybrid_mode: > 0: base mode (the arm goal moves with the base); <= 0: arm mode (default -1)
